guard: the shared CI-chain parser accepts the root package's bare smoke script as well as smoke:* names
why: The gate inventory has deliberately audited the bare smoke script since the audited set was repaired, but the one CI-chain parser accepted only smoke:* names. The suite was therefore visible as debt and impossible to add to the chain.
The parser now accepts exactly smoke or smoke:<non-empty token grammar>; malformed near-misses, including smoke:, remain loud refusals.

mutations.name: restore the smoke-colon-only chain grammar
mutations.expectRed: the bare root smoke script is a valid chain entry
mutations.cell: the bare root smoke script is a valid chain entry
